author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
What happens when you combine A Warcraft 3 Mod With A Moba, Roguelite and Tower Defence? You get Eversiege: Untold Ages. A Brand new game from Tindalos Interactive the chaps behind Battle Fleet Gothic Armada and Aliens Dark Descent. Now this game is a glorious mix of strategy and Roguelite elements to create a game where every run is different and requires a combination of getting lucky and playing smart to truly overpower the enemy and break the game! 

Now This Video Is Sponsored and you can checkout the game here: https://bitly.dearvillagers.com/EverSiege_TheSpiffingBrit
The game will be on a Steam Sale For €/$14,99 with launch discount, and €/$19,99 afterwards. Now I get a lot of sponsorship offers come through everyday and 99% of them we dont take. But when this game came through and I played it for the first time I knew I had to show off the gameplay as its such a fun unique concept!
